requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse the product catalog

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products with name, price, and image
Products can be listed without signing in

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view detailed information about a product

criteria.must: Selecting a product opens a detail view showing its description, price, and stock status

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add products to a cart

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
Adding a sold-out product to the cart is prevented

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view and edit the contents of their cart

criteria.must: The cart view lists each item with its quantity and subtotal
Changing an item's quantity updates the cart total
Removing an item deletes it from the cart

requirements.statement: Shoppers can check out without creating an account

criteria.must: Checkout can be completed while not signed in, using a contact email

requirements.statement: Shoppers can pay for their order by card

criteria.must: Checkout collects card payment details and submits a charge before creating the order
A declined or failed card payment prevents the order from being created

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive an email confirmation after placing an order

criteria.must: A confirmation email is sent after a successful order

requirements.statement: Shoppers can sign in to an account

criteria.must: A shopper can sign in via the platform sign-in flow

requirements.statement: Signed-in shoppers can view their order history

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper sees a list of their own past orders
A shopper cannot view another shopper's orders

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can sign in to an admin area

criteria.must: The admin area is reachable only after signing in
A non-admin signed-in shopper cannot reach the admin area

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can add, edit, and remove products in the catalog

criteria.must: The Store Admin can create a new product with name, description, price, and image
The Store Admin can edit an existing product's details
The Store Admin can remove a product from the catalog

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can set and update stock quantities for each product

criteria.must: The Store Admin can set a product's stock quantity
The catalog reflects the updated stock quantity immediately after the change

requirements.statement: Products automatically show as sold out when stock reaches zero

criteria.must: A product with zero stock is displayed as sold out to shoppers
A sold-out product cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can view incoming orders to fulfill them

criteria.must: The admin order list shows every order regardless of which shopper placed it
Each order in the admin list shows its items, total, and status
